description:
Discover proven composition patterns. With pattern='nested_dashboard', return a complete
        spec showing a Graph supernode with its own dashboard, a Graph portal card on the parent
        dashboard, named input/output ports, and a parameter exposed through two graph levels.
        The native desktop application provides child-dashboard navigation and Back to parent/root
        controls in View mode. Customize after inspecting the current catalog, then create_graph.
name: get_solution_pattern
title: Get a solution pattern
